reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) > 3000000
alternatives: SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY store_code HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) > 3000000
SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) > 3000000
